items.do: Stop making posts that get shared without converting
items.number: +894 followers a month at stake at the current cadence
items.why: 18 of 103 rated posts are shared above the median (26.1/1k) but convert below it (2.2/1k): median 13.1k reach for a median 13 followers. The 34 posts that do both average 283 followers each. Share rate and follow rate correlate at only 0.39 — shareable and followable are separate skills, and the first one flatters itself on the home screen.

items.number: +376 followers a month at stake at the current cadence
items.why: The median carousel in the 7-10 band converts 38 followers (91 posts); outside the band, 12 (14 posts). Pooled rate 3.01 vs 1.51 follows per 1k reach — the band is not just reaching more people, it converts better per person reached, so this is not a reach artefact.

items.do: Stop reading the reach number as a result
items.why: Across the 16 posts that passed 100k reach, conversion runs 0.03 to 10.31 follows per 1k — a 395x spread at comparable reach, which is the proof that reach is not what is being measured. Worst: 804.9k reach for 21 followers — "@bhuvan.bam22 one of the most recognisable faces in Indian p". Best: 112.6k reach for 1161 — "Before the seventh century, the Arabian Peninsula was home t". The smaller post took 55x more followers on 7x less reach. Judge a post on follows; reach only sizes the room it was shown in.

items.why: 20 freedom-lane reels: median skip 59.6%, against the 45% gate, and 1 of them passed 20,000 reach. The revision lane's reels reach a median 2.4k. Reels report no follows at all, so reach is the only thing measurable here — and this lane does not get it.

segregation.note: Instagram results do not transfer to YouTube. Across the scripts published to both platforms the two outcomes correlate at r = -0.10, which is no relationship at all. Nothing on this tab may drive a YouTube decision; that is CHANNEL-PERFORMANCE.md section 3.5 as a standing rule.

scenarios.name: Shift to 7-10-card revision carousels (80/20), same cadence
Shifted mix, cadence +2 posts a week

scenario_assumptions: Feed only. Instagram reports `follows` on carousels and images and NEVER on reels, so the 228 reels on this account contribute an unmeasured number of followers on top. Every figure here is a LOWER BOUND on total growth.

Baseline is the 108 feed posts published between 21 and 180 days ago. Younger posts are excluded because `follows` is a lifetime counter and there is only one insights snapshot, so their totals are still accruing.
Cadence held at the observed 20.7 feed posts a month except in the third scenario.

"Expected" uses mean follows per post and therefore assumes breakouts keep happening at the observed rate — the top 10 posts in the baseline carry 54% of its followers. "Floor" uses medians and is what a month with no breakout yields. The truth is usually nearer the floor plus one good post.
Per-cell rates are assumed stable under a mix change. If the revision lane's reach is partly novelty, pushing it to 80% of output will regress toward the floor row, not the expected row.
No seasonality adjustment; the baseline is a single 180-day window.
